mapper.select: SELECT * FROM zentide_change WHERE status='CANDIDATE' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM zentide_change WHERE change_id=#{changeId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_claim WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND claim_type='FACT'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.claim_id) FROM zentide_claim c JOIN zentide_evidence e ON e.claim_id=c.claim_id WHERE c.change_id=#{changeId} AND c.claim_type='FACT'
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_change SET status='PUBLISHED',verification_status='VERIFIED',published_at=COALESCE(published_at,NOW(3)) WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND status='CANDIDATE' AND verification_status='UNVERIFIED'
UPDATE zentide_claim SET status='VERIFIED' WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND status='CANDIDATE'
UPDATE zentide_signal SET status='PROMOTED',promoted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE linked_change_id=#{changeId} AND status IN ('OBSERVING','ASSESSING','CONFLICTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zentide_observation_activity(signal_id,change_id,source_id,stage,status,message) SELECT signal_id,#{changeId},source_id,'VERIFIED','COMPLETED','潮源与变化已完成校准，浪花形成潮变' FROM zentide_signal WHERE linked_change_id=#{changeId}
